name: Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)
excerpt: The Requirements Traceability Matrix lists requirements and tracks how closely they are met.
notes: The Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) is a table that lists requirements and various attributes on how close the project is to meeting those requirements. It is a tool used in project scope management to ensure that all requirements are addressed.
context_summary:
- Lists project requirements
- Tracks how closely requirements are met
- Used in project scope management
